summary: Full backend + frontend test of AI Doctor landing site. All 5 pytest backend tests pass (stats shape, reviews seeded 6+, create-review appears in list, waitlist create + stats increment, invalid email rejected via 422). Full Playwright UI walk-through passes: hero headline, DNA helix canvas, live counters, hero-signup + nav-signup + pricing-free all open signup-dialog, real POST /api/waitlist succeeds and shows signup-success, login mode dialog opens, theme toggle flips html[data-theme] dark<->light, all sections render (features/subjects/pricing/faq/reviews), 8 feature-card-*, 8 subject-card-*, 7 review-card-* (6 seeded + 1 from backend test), FAQ item expands, pricing-pro-btn opens Gumroad in a new tab (studebot.gumroad.com/l/jlpryj).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider FastAPI lifespan handler.
GET /api/stats returns a fresh random studying_now on every request — fine for vanity metric but not deterministic across clients.
POST /api/reviews has no rate-limit / spam protection; public endpoint could be abused to inject reviews shown on landing page. Consider auth or moderation queue.
cards_today counter is incremented by waitlist join (unrelated semantics); mildly misleading but acceptable for marketing-only counter.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ review and one TEST_ waitlist email inserted via pytest (kept, harmless — TEST_ prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_aidoctor_api.py — reusable regression. All data-testids used in review request are wired correctly in the current build.
